summary: Completed public API and UI verification for the six-stage Anti Generic Engine workflow. Health, analysis, AI workflow generation, six structured stages, Mongo persistence, stage navigation, responsive layout, and mobile drawer all passed.
action_items: Consider returning a clear 503 instead of persisting/returning a partial workflow when a later AI stage fails.
critical_code_review_comments: run_workflow catches exceptions after one or more stages and still inserts a partial workflow; this can present an incomplete brand system as successful and does not provide a clear unavailable error for partial AI outages.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ workflow record through the public workflow API for persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API and full desktop/mobile workflow UI are covered. No auth or mocked APIs are used. The AI workflow takes about 40 seconds; test the partial-stage failure path if backend resilience changes.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced. Static review found that the workflow exception handler only raises 503 when zero stages completed; later-stage failures are saved as partial records and returned with HTTP 200.
